subject: Final acceptance clearance, signature windows and firm start date
messages:
From: Claire Chen <claire@acmecloud.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Matt Rivera <matt.r@acmecloud.com>, procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and proposed go-live slot

Vanessa — Thanks for sending the mutual action plan. We reviewed the dates with our ops team and have two asks before we can sign: (1) a confirmed e-sign window that guarantees signatures within a 72-hour block, and (2) a firm start date that allows us two full weeks for integration validation. Can Redwood commit to an Aug 31 production start if signatures are complete by Aug 20?

Also attaching our standard procurement checklist so your legal team can pre-fill fields and reduce back-and-forth.

Appreciate it,
Claire
--
Claire Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Cloud

Attachment: Acme-Procurement-Checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Chen <claire@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and proposed go-live slot

Claire — thanks for the quick read and the checklist. We can commit to the e-sign window and the Aug 31 production start with the following constraints: (a) signatures in the DocuSign envelope by Aug 20 EOD PT, (b) a small SLA exception for token-retention export (we've captured that in the attached RDW-Acme-MAP-v3.pdf), and (c) a one-time onboarding support slot for Aug 31+Sept 1 to help with the first-day runbook.

I’ve looped in Rishi for signoff on the SLA exception and Grace to confirm the onboarding schedule. If legal/procurement needs to redline anything critical, please flag the clause numbers so we can triage in parallel.

Next steps I propose:
- Today (Aug 9): Redwood sends finalized MAP + DocuSign envelope
- By Aug 12: Acme procurement returns any listed redlines
- Aug 13–17: Legal alignment & final approvals
- Aug 18–20: eSign window (target Aug 20 completion)
- Aug 31: Production start (onboarding support Aug 31–Sep 1)

Are we aligned?

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: RDW-Acme-MAP-v3.pdf (stub)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and proposed go-live slot

Vanessa — I reviewed the SLA exception request in RDW-Acme-MAP-v3. The ask on token-retention export is reasonable for a one-off exception; approve with conditions: (1) limit retention export to 30 days post-onboarding for Acme, (2) include audit log entries for any export action, and (3) include a 6-month review to ensure no unexpected policy drift.

If those three conditions are added to the MAP, I’m OK authorizing the e-sign window you proposed. Please confirm the updated clause language before we send to their procurement.

Rishi
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference

> On Aug 9, 2026, Vanessa Ortiz wrote:

From: Claire Chen <claire@acmecloud.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com, Matt Rivera <matt.r@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T10:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and proposed go-live slot

Thanks — team reviewed Rishi's proposed guardrails and that looks acceptable. Procurement will do a quick pass and return any non-substantive redlines (mainly contact details and insurance addenda). We do have one operational constraint: our PKI team requires the integration validation window to include an initial smoke test on Friday Aug 28 between 07:00–11:00 PT. Can Redwood guarantee a short window that day for an early smoke run?

If so, we’ll aim to have legal signoff by Aug 13 so the eSign window can proceed as planned.

—Claire

> On Aug 10, 2026, Rishi Malhotra wrote:
> > Vanessa — I reviewed the SLA exception request...

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Chen <claire@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and proposed go-live slot

Claire — we can reserve the smoke test window on Aug 28 07:00–11:00 PT. Grace, can you confirm the engineering on-call for that slot and the runbook owner? Dylan — please add the smoke test to the onboarding checklist and confirm rollback triggers.

I’ve updated clause language per Rishi (see attached SLA-exception-request-2026-08-10.pdf) and added the audit-log requirement and 30-day retention cap. If procurement is OK, we’ll publish the DocuSign envelope today and set the eSign window Aug 18–20 (earlier than the Aug 18–20 range I initially proposed, to give you one more buffer day).

Claire — if Aug 13 is still your target for legal signoff, we’re aligned for the rest.

Best,
Vanessa

Attachment: SLA-exception-request-2026-08-10.pdf (stub)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Chen <claire@acmecloud.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-12T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Final signoff: go/no-go and DocuSign envelope sent

All — quick note to confirm final approvals and next steps. I reviewed the updated MAP and SLA exception language; Rishi’s conditions are captured and procurement redlines were non-substantive. I’ve authorized the DocuSign envelope to be sent. Vanessa — DocuSign link below; Claire/procurement, please complete signatures by Aug 20 EOD PT to meet the Aug 31 production start.

DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC12345

Operational notes (runbook excerpts):
- Aug 28 07:00–11:00 PT: Acme smoke test (Grace on-call; Dylan runbook owner)
- Aug 31 09:00 PT: Production handoff and onboarding support (2 engineers for first 48 hours)
- Post-launch: First 6-month policy review scheduled Feb 1, 2027

If signatures miss the Aug 20 window, we will need to slide the start date to Sep 14 to preserve the 2-week validation block and engineer availability. Please acknowledge.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Onboarding & Reliability
Redwood Inference
